name: Zibusiso Ferrante-Nakawé
role: Loan shark and debt enforcer operating out of Gravesend Basin
location: Gravesend Basin — runs collections from a tea house called The Silt Cup on Mucker's Row, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Zibusiso is a heavyset woman with deep brown skin mapped by old keloid scars she's never had removed — she calls them her receipts. Her hair is grown long and locked, threaded with copper wire and small data chips she claims hold the records of every debt ever owed to her. Her eyes have been modded with a golden spiral iris pattern, and she wears reading lenses over them when working numbers, which is always. She dresses in layered kente-stripe synthfabric and keeps her hands conspicuously unaugmented — soft, manicured, rings on every finger — because she wants people to notice she doesn't need chrome to hurt them.

Zibusiso is meticulous, patient, and genuinely warm in the way that predators sometimes are. She remembers birthdays, asks after sick relatives, and will extend grace periods with apparent generosity before the mood shifts into something cold and absolute. She doesn't threaten — she simply describes consequences in precise, accountant-level detail. People leave her table feeling both comforted and terrified, which is exactly how she likes it.

core_fears: losing control of her ledger — being owed something she cannot collect
being seen as weak or sentimental
core_desires: absolute clarity about where she stands with everyone
to build something lasting that outlives her
coping_mechanisms: meticulous record-keeping as a form of control
blind_spots: she underestimates the loyalty networks of tight-knit families and communities
she believes everyone has a price and misses people who genuinely don't
psychology.secret: She has been quietly forgiving the debts of a small cluster of families in the Basin whose children remind her of the daughter she gave up for adoption twenty years ago — she has no idea the daughter is now working three blocks away as a dock loader

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and formal with a warm veneer — uses financial metaphors for everything, switches to blunt declarative sentences when the warmth is done
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and unhurried, never raises her voice
verbal_tics: 'Let's be clear about the numbers here'
example_lines: You borrowed forty, the month rolled twice, so what you owe now is fifty-eight and my goodwill, which I'm told is worth something.
I'm not angry with you, sweetheart. Anger is for people who didn't see this coming. I saw this coming.

story_hooks: A debtor who cannot pay has disappeared — Zibusiso suspects foul play and wants to know if the debt died with them or if someone is hiding them
She approaches the players because someone has been forging her collection receipts, undercutting her reputation and skimming payments
Her daughter has unknowingly taken out a loan from Zibusiso's operation and Zibusiso is in agony about what to do
narrative_function: Quest giver, financial pressure source, information broker on who owes whom, moral complication — she's not cartoonishly evil and can be genuinely helpful if approached correctly.
augmentations: Golden spiral iris genemod. Subdermal haptic feedback in fingertips for counting physical currency and detecting forgeries. No combat chrome.
daily_life: Opens The Silt Cup at 0600, reviews her ledger over tea, conducts morning collections by 1000, then spends afternoons making new loans and managing the social ecosystem of favors and debts she's built across the Basin.
affiliation: Independent — loosely allied with the Gravesend Basin crew known as the Mudline Compact

decision_rules: Never lend to someone who cannot name two people who will vouch for them
Always give one genuine warning before escalating
escalation_ladder: Cold formal notice with explicit timeline
Send an enforcer for a visible social visit — no violence yet
Disappearance of something the debtor loves

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Gracious and curious, offers tea, asks questions — gathering information under the guise of hospitality
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely warm but always slightly transactional — affection is real but never fully separated from what they're worth to her

stress_responses.low: Counts her rings, one by one, under the table
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very quiet, lets silence do the work
stress_responses.high: Retreats to her ledger, refuses further conversation until she's recalculated everything

contradictions: Genuinely fond of people she is also willing to ruin
Believes in fairness even within a system she knows is predatory
habits: Keeps a handwritten ledger in addition to her digital one — she doesn't fully trust either alone
breaking_points: Discovering her daughter is in her debt system
Someone physically destroying her physical ledger
